title: Lightly Crispy German Grape Nuts Fritters
description: A kid-friendly German dish featuring grape nut cereal, these fritters are buttery and crispy on the outside, and soft on the inside. They are perfect for a halal-friendly snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and vanilla extract.
Add the melted butter to the egg mixture and whisk until combined.
Add the crushed Grape Nuts cereal to the egg mixture and stir until well coated.
Add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a cookie scoop or spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are lightly crispy and golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy.
